nodes.label: .husky/pre-commit Hook
nodes.rationale: The CI workflow replicates the local pre-commit hook in the cloud so merges are blocked even if a developer does not have the hook running locally.

nodes.label: Lint/Format Gate
nodes.rationale: Before declaring a task done, formatting/lint must pass clean: backend 'ruff format . && ruff check .', frontend 'npx prettier --check .' (or npm run format:check). Never declare done with unformatted files.

nodes.label: CI GitHub Workflow
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the local .husky/pre-commit hook in the cloud so GitHub blocks the merge even when the developer does not have the hook running. Runs on PRs to main and pushes to main.

nodes.label: nombres Template Tag Library
nodes.rationale: Custom Django template tag library loaded with {% load nombres %}, providing the nombre_completo filter used to greet users by full name in all transactional email templates.

nodes.label: docs/decisiones.md Decision Log
nodes.rationale: Every relevant design/architecture/implementation change must be recorded in docs/decisiones.md (date DD/MM/AAAA, short title, description, affected files) before a design decision is considered closed.

nodes.label: Domain Documentation (docs 01-05)
nodes.rationale: Domain docs in docs/ (files 01 to 05) are the source of truth; code must stay consistent with them, and if they diverge the docs must be updated to reflect reality or the change agreed first.

nodes.label: django-allauth 65.19.1
nodes.rationale: Pinned to the exact version 65.19.1 because allauth.account.internal.flows.email_verification (used by usuarios.views.ConfirmarCorreoView) is not public API and can change between minor releases; 65.19.1 is the installed and tested version in the container.

nodes.label: Account Confirmation Email
nodes.rationale: Transactional email that activates the FilmAI account via an activate_url link valid for 24 hours; includes HTML and plain-text variants plus a signup (welcome) variant; sends through django-allauth's email verification flow.

nodes.label: Password Recovery Email
nodes.rationale: Transactional email for password reset with a reset_url valid for 1 hour; if the user did not request the change their password is not modified; HTML and plain-text variants.

nodes.label: Backend Service (filmai_backend)
nodes.rationale: Django + DRF container; runs as the host user (${UID:-1000}:${GID:-1000}) so generated files are owned by the developer without sudo; mounts ./backend for hot reload; depends on healthy db and redis.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Service (filmai_db)
nodes.rationale: postgres:16-alpine image with pgdata named volume so data survives docker compose down; healthcheck via pg_isready; port 5432 exposed for host tools like DBeaver.

nodes.label: Frontend Service (filmai_frontend)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 + Tailwind + Shadcn container; reuses the global GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID as NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (Next.js only exposes NEXT_PUBLIC_* prefixed env vars); anonymous /app/node_modules volume so container modules are not overwritten; depends on backend.

nodes.label: Redis Service (filmai_redis)
nodes.rationale: redis:7-alpine used as TMDB cache and Celery broker, with redisdata volume and redis-cli ping healthcheck.

nodes.label: pgvector + Ollama Embeddings (planned)
nodes.rationale: Planned Module 5 feature: ProduccionEmbedding 1:1 with ProduccionAudiovisual, pgvector(1024) vector + HNSW index, asynchronous generation via Celery with pending/processing/ready/failed states; feeds the chatbot's buscar_semantico.

nodes.label: FilmAI
nodes.rationale: Web platform for movie reviews with intelligent recommendations. Addresses the choice paradox of streaming overabundance: generic popularity-based recommendations rarely capture individual taste, so the system combines a TMDB-synced catalog with a personalized LLM chatbot that analyzes watch history, ratings and reviews.

nodes.label: LLM Recommendation Chatbot
nodes.rationale: Chatbot accessed via a floating button on every screen; processes natural-language queries using history, ratings and preferences. Sensitive data (email, first and last name) is anonymized before being sent to the LLM provider; in-flight requests can be cancelled.

nodes.label: usuarios.Usuario (AUTH_USER_MODEL)
nodes.rationale: Single identity entity after the Persona/Usuario/Administrador hierarchy was eliminated (see docs/decisiones.md); the admin role is handled by native is_staff/is_superuser flags of the Django Admin.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Developed following the POUR principles of WCAG 2.1 at AA conformance: 4.5:1 contrast, keyboard operability, visible focus, ARIA roles, 200% zoom legibility; verified against the WebAIM WCAG 2 Checklist.

nodes.label: Email Confirmation Signup Plain Text Template
nodes.norm_label: email confirmation signup plain text template

nodes.label: 33 AI Writing Patterns
nodes.rationale: LLMs use statistical algorithms to guess what should come next, tending toward the most statistically likely result. Approach is 'rewrite, don't delete' (keep coverage of the original), preserve meaning, never invent facts; a draft → audit → final loop catches lingering AI-isms.

nodes.label: Voice Calibration
nodes.rationale: When the user provides a writing sample, analyze sentence rhythm, word choices and quirks and apply them to the rewrite instead of producing generic 'clean' output; without a sample, fall back to neutral plain prose for technical content and a natural varied voice for personal writing.

nodes.label: Conventional Commit Decision Gates
nodes.rationale: Every commit message follows type(scope): description with exactly one of 11 allowed types (feat, fix, chore, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, revert); description is lowercase, imperative mood, no trailing period; revert has no scope.

nodes.label: No AI Attribution Rule
nodes.rationale: Never add AI attribution such as Co-Authored-By to commits.

nodes.label: MUST/SHOULD/NEVER Quality Rules
nodes.rationale: Post-implementation quality gate auditing interactions, animation, layout, accessibility, performance, dark mode and design. MUST violations are blocking, SHOULD are warnings, NEVER violations are blocking MUST findings; the skill never rewrites code directly, it reports Category | Rule | Severity | File:Line | Issue | Fix.

nodes.label: AI Review GitHub Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs Nikita-Filonov/ai-review on PRs (opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review) with OpenRouter as LLM provider, GitHub as VCS, FULL_FILE_DIFF review mode and fetch-depth 0 so git diff works correctly.
